evidence.exception: No live provider/model calls; models and transport responses are isolated fixtures. Source selection and factual accuracy are not established. Callback-reference capture is test-only instrumentation; callback body unchanged. Research and WhatsApp functions are selected from actual TypeScript by AST; unrelated module startup excluded. No split-text path exists in the current news reply consumers; long text tested through the actual same send path. Ephemeral candidates are intentionally not persisted: a process crash after send but before asynchronous seen bookkeeping can leave an article eligible again. No retry or new persistence added. Existing upstream request/task replay policy is unchanged; affected lifecycle regressions cover preserved closure and no automatic repeat after uncertain delivery.
